name: pdfbolt
description: Generate PDFs from HTML, web pages, or saved templates. Create, preview, and manage reusable PDF templates with PDFBolt.

interface.longDescription: Generate PDFs from HTML, web pages, or published PDFBolt templates. Create and edit reusable template drafts, validate content, preview and compare PDFs, and publish or delete templates when requested. Connect a PDFBolt account through OAuth. New Free accounts include starter conversion credits. Rendering uses conversion credits; listing templates, checking usage, and validating content does not.
defaultPrompt: Use PDFBolt to generate a one-page project proposal PDF with placeholder details.
Create a reusable PDFBolt proposal template, preview it, and save a draft without publishing.
List my PDFBolt templates and check my usage without changing or rendering anything.
